I recently visited this Chinese restaurant and had a really good experience. The ambiance was warm and welcoming with a nice balance of traditional Chinese decor and a modern touch. The staff were polite, attentive and quick with service.

The food was the real highlight — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. The Wantons were soft and juicy, the hot and sour soup had just the right balance and the Kenji potato fry was perfectly spiced without. Portion sizes were generous, making it good value for money.

I also appreciated that they offered variety of vegetarian options so there’s something for the Veggies lovers.

Overall, it’s a great spot for family dinners, casual outings or even takeout. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone who enjoys authentic Chinese flavors with good service.

featured_reviews.name: Bombay Bhukkad Gang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mainland China at Viviana Mall in Thane-West is a delightful fusion of luxurious Thai-Chinese ambiance and comfortable seating. The staff's guidance in suggesting dishes adds to the experience, especially if you opt for the unlimited buffet.

The starters, served tableside, showcase authentic Chinese dim sums that tantalize the taste buds with its yumminess. The Lung Fung soup, though slightly watery, surprises with its flavorful egg white fry. The diced chicken with assorted pepper might lack the pronounced assorted pepper flavour but compensates with its overall deliciousness and yumminess.

Moving to the mains, the Tsing Hoi chicken and Mandarin fish in gravy complement steamed rice exceptionally, creating a mouthwatering ensemble. As for desserts, the honey noodles combined with vanilla ice cream provide a heavenly blend of crispness and sweetness, while the chocolate rolls may sometimes be overwhelming with their chocolate chunks.

The continuous and consistent serving on the my table was something that we lacked and made a bit of disappointment as we had to wait for the food to arrive .
Priced reasonably at 745 for a 10-course lunch, the experience is exceptional, especially for non-vegetarians indulging in sumptuous dim sums and flavorful chicken starters. While I didn't explore the vegetarian selection, the variety offered assures a balanced culinary adventure. Overall, a fabulous dining journey with a mix of standout dishes and a comfortable sitting.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered takeout from Cantonese Chinese after seeing numerous 4 and 5-star reviews. The food arrived in about 45 minutes, and the packaging was excellent—no leaks in any containers, not even the soup, which was a pleasant surprise given my past experiences with oil leaks in other deliveries. My first impression was very positive.

We ordered a variety of vegetarian items: spring rolls, Manchurian, Schezwan fried rice, Sherpa rice, monchow soup, and lemon soup. Upon opening the containers, I was a bit surprised to find the spring rolls soggy, as if they had been dipped in sauce. The food looked appetizing, but the first bite of the spring roll was extremely spicy—unlike any spring rolls I've had before, which are usually mild.

Both the soup and Manchurian were also extremely spicy, to the point where I couldn't enjoy any of the flavors. Fortunately, the Sherpa rice was not spicy. If you're not a fan of very spicy food, this place might not be for you. Even my family members, who can handle a fair amount of spice, found the food overwhelmingly spicy. My mouth was burning by the end of the meal, and I didn't enjoy the food at all.

I'm giving two stars solely based on the excellent packaging and timely delivery.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Cheng's for the first time last Dec. 2022 and I must say that the food we had was one of the best Chinese food, flavour packed full of dishes! I wished I had two tummies, since one was just not enough to satisfy by happy greed to eat more!

Being a vegetarian, I wasn't disappointed! Their Momos is a must have! Trust me, their vegetarian Momos are out of the world! My favorite was their soya Momos and their bottle gourd Momos! Then tried their lemon coriander soup which was blissful and lite! Forgetting the main course name, put attaching pictures so that whoever reads this can look for these dishes! We also ordered (as take away) something like a chilli paneer kind of dish (again forgetting it's name) which was 10/10! Check out the picture (not the best shot)

Another yummy stuff they have is their Momo sauce & schezwan sauce- if they sold it in bottles I would definitely buy them!

Staff is extremely humble, and the place is clean! Love their little outdoor seating arrangement!

This has become my go to place when I need good Chinese food but without going through the hassle of booking a table in big restaurants! I wish they can open more branches of Cheng's Chinese Kitchen in other locations in Mumbai!

Would like to end with one thing, that people here have put a lot of love in the menu that is curated, leading to their dishes that gets prepared before it finally reaches out plates!

featured_reviews.name: Rayhan achwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Fat Kong, Jogeshwari West.

Despite specifically requesting a simple meal modification for a child, the staff completely ignored the request. When dining with children, basic customer requests should be taken seriously, but unfortunately that was not the case here.

What was even more concerning was the noticeable decline in food quality. The food lacked the freshness and taste that Fat Kong was once known for. Portions and presentation were below expectations, and the overall dining experience felt far from the standards the restaurant used to maintain.

Cleanliness has also deteriorated significantly. The dining area and overall upkeep gave an impression of poor maintenance and lack of attention to hygiene, which is unacceptable for any restaurant.

This used to be a place I would happily recommend, but after this visit, I am extremely disappointed. Management needs to urgently address customer service, food quality, and cleanliness before more loyal customers are lost.

featured_reviews.name: Anas Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff lacks basic courtesy and speaks to customers as if they’re doing us a favor by serving food, which is completely unacceptable. I ordered crispy threaded chicken online, and when I asked for the usual sauces & condiments that are normally provided free when dining in the person on the call was incredibly rude and insisted I pay extra offline just to get them. What made it worse was the attitude: dismissive, arrogant, and disrespectful. On top of that, the food quality has clearly gone downhill over time. If a restaurant can’t respect its guests, it doesn’t deserve their business. You’re better off eating at a roadside stall where prices are lower and customers are treated with basic decency. Definitely not ordering from here again.
